question_text: The Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) is a government-owned and controlled corporation (GOCC) that regulates and operates gambling activities. Which of the following best describes the governance structure of PAGCOR?

options.text: It is headed by a Board of Directors appointed by the President, with the Chairman and CEO serving at the pleasure of the President.
It is directly under the Office of the President and managed by a single Administrator appointed by the President.
It is governed by a Commission composed of five members appointed by the President for a fixed term of seven years.
It is a subsidiary of the Department of Finance and managed by the Secretary of Finance.
